validity.summary: Confirmed real, currently-active, non-duplicate object; distinct entity from neighboring P4092 (Priozersk-Ikhala).
validity.detail: P4093 (Ikhala-Sortavala) is confirmed as a real, currently-planned pipeline object, NOT a duplicate of P4092 (Priozersk-Ikhala): the federal territorial-planning decree (Пр РФ 816-р/2015, government.ru) lists them as TWO SEPARATE numbered items -- item 45 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС Ихала' (Leningrad Oblast + Karelia, capacity 54.633 million m3/y, matching P4092's recorded 0.0546 bcm/y) and item 47 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС Сортавала' (Karelia only: Лахденпохский + Сортавальский districts, capacity 69.945 million m3/y, matching P4093's recorded 0.07 bcm/y). The two capacity figures are distinct and each independently matches its respective GEM row within rounding -- strong evidence these are a genuine consecutive/chained pair of отводы (P4092 feeding toward/through Ikhala from Priozersk direction, P4093 continuing from Ikhala to Sortavala), exactly as the task's own guidance anticipated, not a single object double-entered under two names. Current existence and active-plan status as of 2026-09-15 (today) is independently confirmed by: gazprommap.ru's LIVE page (fetched today) still listing 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС «Сортавала»' with done=0 under the CURRENT 2026-2030 Karelia gasification programme; a 2022 Wayback capture of the same page showing the identical object, also done=0, under the then-current 2021-2025 programme (i.e. carried forward unbuilt across two full 5-year programme cycles, 4+ years of continuous documented inclusion); and neftegaz.ru (2023-04-03) naming Ikhala and Sortavala отводы together as objects of the actualized programme. No source anywhere suggests this object has been cancelled, merged into another entry, or was ever a mislabeling of P4092.

validity.summary: PipelineType='distribution' is contestable; structural evidence points to transmission/trunk-level (отвод feeding a ГРС), consistent with a batch-wide pattern. Flagged only, not reclassified.
validity.detail: GEM records PipelineType=distribution for P4093, but the object is officially a 'газопровод-отвод' (branch/lateral gas pipeline) FEEDING INTO a ГРС (газораспределительная станция, gas distribution station) -- per the batch-wide heuristic (task instructions), an отвод feeding a ГРС is transmission-side infrastructure; true distribution is the downstream межпоселковый/внутрипоселковый network past the ГРС, which this object is not. This is corroborated by a structural signal I verified directly: the federal territorial-planning decree (Пр РФ 816-р/2015, government.ru), which is the FEDERAL PIPELINE TRANSPORT infrastructure scheme, lists item 47 'Газопровод-отвод и ГРС Сортавала' explicitly -- i.e. this отвод+ГРС object is classified under federal TRANSPORT infrastructure planning, not under any regional/local distribution-network scheme. Regional gasification-programme documents (gazprommap.ru, neftegaz.ru) that separately cover downstream межпоселковый distribution build-out for Karelia list this object in the same 'газопровод-отвод' category as other trunk-level отводы, not in a separate downstream-distribution category. Per task instructions this is flagged as a contested classification concern only -- NOT reclassified -- pending a batch-wide decision on the distribution-vs-transmission question for отвод+ГРС objects generally (this pattern likely recurs across other Karelia/NW rows in this batch, e.g. P4092).

This numeric match (69.945 -> 0.070 bcm/y) is also the basis for identifying item 47, rather than the neighboring item 45 'ГРС Ихала' (54.633 million m3/y, matching P4092 instead), as the correct decree entry for P4093.
